title: The Sorcerer at Dusk
description: A hooded figure in an ornate purple robe stands on a rocky shore at night, holding a glowing lantern in one hand and a burning staff emitting thick dark smoke in the other. The scene includes a misty body of water, dense dark trees, and glowing embers on the ground under a deep blue and purple sky.
